vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1739: Command Deck issue tree hides strike agents (already fixed on main — add regression lock) and renders dead sessions as 'working' (frontend presence-authoritative fix)

plan.title: bug(dashboard): Command Deck tree — lock strike allowlist against a 5th regression, and stop rendering dead (presence=ended) sessions as 'working'
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: Two defects in the Command Deck ProjectTree. RC1: the isWorkOrSpecialistSession allowlist in FeatureItem.tsx dropped 'strike', so strike sessions did not count toward a feature's aggregate badges/activity/edge color — the 4th allowlist a strike had fallen out of. RC2: a dead planning session (tmux killed ~20 min earlier) rendered as 'working · 22m' with a green running icon, active dot, and an ever-growing timer. RC1's code is ALREADY fixed on origin/main (commit 2e5f3a9214, 2026-06-12), but the exact enumeration that regressed four times has no unit test. RC2 is still reproducible: presence is correctly derived from tmux ('ended' when no session), but SessionNode.tsx prefers the stale live runtime.activity over presence, so a dead session with a frozen activity:'working' snapshot renders as alive.
narratives.Proposal: Two independent frontend beads. (1) RC1 regression lock: export isWorkOrSpecialistSession and add a unit test asserting every current session type — including 'strike' — is recognized, so a future dropped type fails CI. No behavior change; RC1 is not re-implemented. (2) RC2 fix: make presence==='ended' the authoritative liveness signal in SessionNode.tsx — effectiveActivity returns undefined on ended, isLiveActivity is gated on isLive so a stale backend status can't paint the icon green, and the growing duration label is suppressed for non-live sessions. Both beads are single-file frontend changes, independently mergeable, each proven by its own vitest test.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT re-implement RC1 (strike allowlist entry + SessionNode strike label/purpose) — already landed on main as commit 2e5f3a9214.
- Do NOT build the canonical session-prefix/role registry (PAN-1683) that would derive every allowlist from one source — that is the structural fix, out of scope here.
- Do NOT build a backend liveness reaper that emits agent.stopped/agent.status_changed when a tmux session dies externally (PAN-1689 family).
- Do NOT change backend status/duration computation in collectSessionTreeNodes (routes/projects.ts) — the feature aggregate already presence-gates isRunningSession, so the stale backend status is not user-visible.
- Do NOT touch the Activity-cockpit twin builder (routes/command-deck.ts) or its rendering — a separate code path, not the reported ProjectTree surface.
- Do NOT change the LIVE-session rendering: a running session (presence active/idle + activity working) must still render the green sessionIconRunning icon and active dot.

autoDecisions.summary: Scoped RC1 to a regression-lock test (export + unit test over isWorkOrSpecialistSession) rather than any code change, because the RC1 fix already landed on main (2e5f3a9214).
autoDecisions.rationale: Re-implementing a landed fix is churn; the real gap is the untested enumeration that has silently regressed four times. A pure-predicate unit test is the minimal, highest-value guard.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixed RC2 in the frontend (SessionNode.tsx) by making presence==='ended' authoritative, instead of a backend status rewrite or a new reaper.
autoDecisions.rationale: presence is already correctly reconciled against tmux (services/session-presence.ts). The visible defect is purely the frontend preferring stale runtime.activity. A frontend fix is the smallest change that corrects every session type uniformly, regardless of how the tmux died.

autoDecisions.summary: Suppress the duration label for non-live sessions rather than freezing it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The backend supplies no endedAt (duration = now - startedAt), so a correct lifetime cannot be shown. The existing 'last heard N ago' already conveys recency, so suppression loses no information while removing the misleading ever-growing timer.

items.title: Export isWorkOrSpecialistSession and unit-test that every session type (incl. 'strike') is recognized

expected_outputs: FeatureItem.test.tsx passes including the new isWorkOrSpecialistSession allowlist test

narrative.Action: RC1 (the strike-omitting allowlist and the SessionNode strike label/purpose) is already fixed on origin/main via commit 2e5f3a9214 — do NOT re-implement it. Close the actual gap: the isWorkOrSpecialistSession allowlist in FeatureItem.tsx:327 is an unexported pure predicate with no unit test, and it has silently dropped 'strike' four times. Add the `export` keyword to `function isWorkOrSpecialistSession` at FeatureItem.tsx:327 (no logic change; it is already consumed internally at :996). Then in FeatureItem.test.tsx add a `describe('isWorkOrSpecialistSession')` block importing the now-exported predicate and asserting it returns true for each current member of the allowlist — work, strike, planning, review, reviewer, test, ship, merge — via `isWorkOrSpecialistSession({ type } as SessionNode)`, and returns false for a non-member such as `{ type: 'legacy' }`. This test would have failed on all four prior misses; a fifth dropped type fails CI.

items.title: isWorkOrSpecialistSession, imported from FeatureItem.tsx (now exported), returns true when called with a { type: 'strike' } session
The predicate returns true for each other current allowlist type: work, planning, review, reviewer, test, ship, merge
The predicate returns false when called with a non-allowlisted type such as { type: 'legacy' }, so it is not trivially true
SessionNode: honor presence==='ended' so a dead session never renders as working/running with a growing timer

expected_outputs: SessionNode.test.tsx passes including the new dead-session (presence 'ended' + stale activity 'working') test and the existing live-session test

narrative.Action: Make presence the authoritative liveness signal in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/ProjectTree/SessionNode.tsx. Three coupled edits, all honoring 'presence ended ⇒ not live': (1) In effectiveActivity (starts :97), add as the FIRST line after the `if (!runtime?.activity) return undefined;` guard: `if (presence === 'ended') return undefined;` — a dead session has no live activity. Leave the existing `if (runtime.activity === 'stopped' && presence !== 'ended') return 'idle';` branch intact for live sessions (H2). (2) In the render body, gate isLiveActivity (:664) on isLive (:610, already `presence in {active,idle,suspended}`): change to `const isLiveActivity = isLive && !isPaused && (statusCssKey === 'running' || statusCssKey === 'working' || statusCssKey === 'thinking' || statusCssKey === 'starting');` so a stale backend status==='running' on a dead node cannot paint the icon with styles.sessionIconRunning. (3) Suppress the growing duration for non-live sessions: change durationLabel (:674) to `const durationLabel = isLive ? formatDuration(session.duration) : null;` (D4 — the '· 22m' timer). Add a regression test to SessionNode.test.tsx modeled on the existing live-working test at :256: set runtimeById['planning-dead'] = { activity: 'working', lastActivity: '2026-05-06T11:55:00.000Z' } and render a session { sessionId: 'planning-dead', type: 'planning', presence: 'ended', status: 'stopped' }; assert the row does NOT contain styles.sessionIconRunning, the status dot data-status is not 'active' (it is 'ended'), and no duration label renders. Keep/add a live-session assertion (presence 'active' + activity 'working' still shows sessionIconRunning) to prove no regression.

items.title: Given a SessionNode with presence 'ended' and runtime activity 'working', when rendered it does NOT apply the styles.sessionIconRunning (live) icon class
Given that same dead session, the status dot renders data-status 'ended' (not 'active') — deriveDotStatus falls back to presence instead of the stale activity
Given that same dead session, no duration label is rendered (durationLabel is suppressed for !isLive), so the misleading growing '· 22m' timer disappears

Given a LIVE session (presence 'active', runtime activity 'working'), the row still applies styles.sessionIconRunning — the live-rendering path is preserved (no regression to SessionNode.test.tsx:256)
